services.title: Paint and refinishing
services.body: Colour is matched to the car in front of us and blended into the next panel so the repair does not show.

services.title: Collision repair
services.body: Damage is measured against the factory points before the first panel comes off, and the estimate reflects what is actually bent.

evidence.text: Took my wife's Honda CR-V to get the body repaired after a small collision.
evidence.also: They replaced my hood and headlights and made it look like the car had never seen an accident.

services.title: Dent and body work
services.body: Panels are pulled, filled and blocked flat by hand before any primer goes on.

evidence.text: I've sent my Saturn Vue there twice for body work when I was hit by another driver and he was excellent at coordinating
evidence.also: He assisted with a minor repair under my bumper due to an individual who backed into me in a parking lot.

services.title: Insurance claim repairs
services.body: The estimate is written to what the damage actually is, and the car goes back the way it was.

evidence.text: They communicated well with me and my insurance company, made recommendations on ways to trim costs, and fixed my vehicl
evidence.also: He handled my Ford Escape's repairs very quickly and worked with my insurance company directly.

reviews.author: sudie brown
reviews.text: Never received any services. The Co. dealt strictly with State Farm. Never received or saw a written statement of the damages to the underside of my car.

reviews.author: Latarsha Higgs-Lassiter
reviews.text: Mr. Donnie Garris does fantastic work. My car has been there twice and after the work done, I was totally pleased. I will recommend his service to my family and friends

reviews.author: Julian Hamilton
reviews.text: Donnie and his team perfectly colormatched some primed factory parts (both bumpers and door handles) to match my factory tricoat 2022 f250. Not an easy task and they nailed it. Donnie is a friendly guy too. See attached picture. The rear bumper was primed gray before Donnie and his team colormatched it perfectly.

reviews.author: Birdie Pitt
reviews.text: Brandi was totally awesome!! My experience from start to finish was five star. I was given alerts on every step of the process. I even was able to speak to the gentleman handling my son's car and he was very knowledgeable, professional and courteous!! This team will not let you down!!

reviews.author: Kelli Williams
reviews.text: They were a preferred place with my car insurance. Drop car off and rental will pick you up at the shop. Very simple. However it took 2 WEEKS to estimate the hail damage and determine my car was totaled. So I had a rental for 2 weeks for a car that was totally driveable. Bad business model, the car ins company is just throwing $ away on a rental. Never had an estimate take 2 weeks.

reviews.author: susann mathews
reviews.text: Service was great, employees are friendly. Job was done perfectly, car was cleaner then I left it. I left a 4 instead of five because the car spray they use literally smells like the blue water of a porta potty. Please change that. I would still use there service, just ask them not to use the car spray they choose.

reviews.author: Dennis McCunney
reviews.text: Donnie and his team were consummate professionals throughout the entire process of getting my 2003 4Runner back up and running. They communicated well with me and my insurance company, made recommendations on ways to trim costs, and fixed my vehicle with awesome craftsmanship. I really appreciate all their hard work and couldn't recommend this crew more highly.

reviews.author: Melvin Casper
reviews.text: Excellent communication from CARSTAR. I was very pleased with their swift work and customer service. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jayla Kamari
reviews.text: I made arrangements with CarStar due to an insurance claim. What was first an unfortunate situation, Brandy at the front desk, made so much better! She was so helpful, understanding, and guided me through the entire process! She has helped earn the business a lifelong customer & I will be referring others!

reviews.author: Jontae Sherrod
reviews.text: Love the experience, they kept me up to date with where they were in the process of fixing my vehicle. I WOULD DEFINITELY RECOMMEND

reviews.author: Mike Carlson
reviews.text: Great service and very professional! I stopped by without an appointment for a problem I was having with my back driver window and was able to get service immediately. The problem was fixed quickly, and I’ve had no problems with it since. I would highly recommend this body shop. Thank you.

reviews.author: Elisa Heller
reviews.text: Repairs took longer than expected but I was completely satisfied with the end result! They even paid for a rental car!! I hope I don’t have the need to use them again, but if I do, I will not hesitate to take my car there again!!!

reviews.author: Lakeisha Mcclary
reviews.text: I went to take photos of my vehicle so that my insurance company could complete a preliminary estimate. Donnie was very rude and disrespectful and told me he would not be working on my vehicle and I needed to have my vehicle moved. While yelling at me he said he don’t work for me and he work on his own time. He said I left a voicemail the day prior telling him to check his voicemail. I explained to him that I did leave a voicemail and maybe he took the message the wrong way and the voicemail was asking him to check his email to confirm if he received the email from snap sheet. I also requested a call back. After not receiving a returned call I went to the shop to only get photos. While I was leaving he stopped me. He was not professional at all. Based off of the other reviews I thought I made a great decision choosing this shop. I understand if he couldn’t or didn’t want to work on my vehicle but he could have been professional about it.

reviews.author: Donna Durand
reviews.text: Donnie and his team are TOP NOTCH! Greenville Auto Body & Paint was recommended to me after a deer hit my car. Donnie kept me informed along the way and made my car look brand new. He was professional and so thorough. His shop is definitely the best on in town. Thanks Donnie for getting me back on the road.

reviews.author: Gvegas 72
reviews.text: Donnie Garris is the nicest and most awesome person. He assisted with a minor repair under my bumper due to an individual who backed into me in a parking lot. Additionally he gave me the options for future to sand and clear coat my headlights and at a reasonable price! He is definitely someone you want to use if you needed any repairs on your automobile. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Taylor Dement
reviews.text: Donnie is an excellent mechanic and businessman. He handled my Ford Escape's repairs very quickly and worked with my insurance company directly. All repairs were done expertly and my car has never looked better! (He and his crew also cleaned my car and vacuumed the inside, a very nice perk!) He always kept me in the loop and made sure I understood everything about what was going on, what needed to be done, and prices. He made every effort to keep my costs down which was greatly appreciated. He even met with me before opening hours to drop off my car, and made other efforts to fit within my schedule. Donnie knows how to run his business! I will be coming back here if I need any work done on my car in the future, and I highly recommend everyone to use Greenville Auto Body and Paint!

reviews.author: Sheila Whitehurst Davis
reviews.text: I damaged my front bumper. I had previous work done by this shop so I decided to use them again. They charged me $1608, then told me I had to take it to another shop never there’s an oil leak. They also wanted to put a fan in the vehicle & I said no. The vehicle doesn’t need it. It had to be towed to another shop to fix the oil leak. Upon getting it back I didn’t drive it for a few days. So 4 days later I notice that there’s a hole in the bumper that didn’t get fixed. I called the shop & told them, they said they would call me back. They didn’t. I called again today & I was told that the part was over $700 and they discussed it with me & I said I didn’t want to pay that. LIE. So now my vehicle is going to a reputable shop, I wouldn’t take a bicycle to this shop.

reviews.author: Wyatt Blackburn
reviews.text: I took my truck here to get repaired. Donnie did an EXCELLENT job. My truck looked great and I got it back on time. He also kept me up to date on everything that was going on. I would recommend this place to anyone needing good quality repairs done.

reviews.author: ReDD-WoLF7
reviews.text: I was highly impressed with this company and the front desk personnel. The ladies were very pleasant professional and very knowledgeable. I, as customers, would be happy to deal with this establishment and will in the future.

reviews.author: Liz Brown-Pickren
reviews.text: What a great business! When the nearby parts I needed seemed too expensive, Donnie found what I needed at a great price, but a long way away. I picked it up and he installed it at, what seems to me, a very decent price. He was fast and the outcome is beautiful. I will be recommending this shop to anybody who needs auto body repair. And if, God forbid, I need another repair, I will certainly come back here. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Michael Wilson
reviews.text: Took my wife's Honda CR-V to get the body repaired after a small collision. They did a phenomenal job in terms of quality and customer service. They even went above and beyond to help me with an unrelated issue. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jatoya Askew
reviews.text: Best service ever. The owner is nice and upfront and did such an amazing job on my Ford. I was amazed to see good quality of work. He is the guy to go to, I will recommend him and will go to him in the future if need to be.

reviews.author: Highland Residential and Commercial Roofing
reviews.text: I Went back today to pick up a parking light that Donnie( the owner) said he would install on our van's exterior front bumper, which had not arrived yet upon our van's completion. We accepted the van anyways with the plan of that being finshed later. They had done a partial paint project on our 2014 Toyota Sienna 45 to 60 days ago, for $3300.00. My wife was not able to get her van back due to her schedule, so I volunteered to pick up the light from his shop in the last recent weeks, and just put the light back in myself, at home! When I walked in today, Donnie, had an adjuster sitting at a desk and they were discussing other informal business matters, etc.... To my dismay, Donnie was extremely rude to me when I showed up, while I was only friendly as usual. I was shocked! He said he sent the light back to the parts supply house, eventhough he didn't call us prior to doing so( I never brought that detail up, today). I asked him if he could reorder it and he said yes, for $40. I said ok, you take cards right, he said yes. I pulled out my AMEX, he said no AMEX. I said ok, here is my debit card... he said how about Cash! I said no, card is better for me. He then refused to order it and told me to go get it from Toyota myself! I then politely restated everything to him, as it just happened in our discusions since I walked in, just to be sure I didn't do/say anything out of line. He confirmed everything as I thought it had just happened! I was surprised at how cavalier, rude, and the such lack of care for a repeat customer! He had done 3-4 vehicles for me, and one my daughter's vehicles too. I've never bickered with him on price, and paid him as soon as he finished. I was really saddened by his attitude and his disrespectful behavior today. Maybe he was trying to show off to that adjuster how successful he thinks he is and how he doesn't need additional business. As he always made a point to say in the past, as a braggart would... He lost my business forever today! Maybe that was his goal? He likes Cash payments vs cards and checks for some unknown IRS reason, I suppose? Very sad for him!

reviews.author: Mitch Kittle
reviews.text: Very professional and polite people. Made sure to thoroughly lay out their plan for repair and price of repair, and even helped to cut down on costs where they could. They replaced my hood and headlights and made it look like the car had never seen an accident. Could not more highly recommend, would refer to friends, family and strangers alike

reviews.author: Joshua Jones
reviews.text: Donnie and his staff were very welcoming when I arrived to get a quote on replacing my front bumper on my 2011 mustang GT. I needed to get the new bumper painted, and put in place of the old bumper that was in bad shape. I appreciate how up front Donnie was with the whole process, and his eye for paint and body work seriously suprised me. It's what you get when you have someone that cares about their business, excellent customer service, and craftmanship rarely seen these days. The painting of my bumper was done in a timely manner considering how busy his shop was at the time, and I was absolutely shocked of the quality. And as a finishing touch they wiped the car down and polished my exhaust tips. That is attention to detail/quality and going above and beyond for the customer. Greenville Auto Body and Paint will have all of my future business needs in regards to paint and body work. I hands down recommend anyone on the edge about paint or body work around Greenville to seriously consider this shop first. There is a reason why they are reviewed so highly.

reviews.author: Chloe Kastanek
reviews.text: The owner of this place has outstanding customer service, he was super nice and helpful throughout the whole repair process. He also gave me a cheaper price to repair my car than everywhere else I looked. My car looks better than before I was even in an accident. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone and I will be coming back here for any other issues I have with my car.

reviews.author: Anna Brownell
reviews.text: Donny and his crew are fantastic to work with. I've sent my Saturn Vue there twice for body work when I was hit by another driver and he was excellent at coordinating with insurance adjusters and getting everything done in a timely manner. He is very vocal and is very likely to call you when he needs your opinion on anything, or to let you know what's going on in general. He's reasonably priced and has made several efforts to keep repair costs down by finding parts that are more afforadable. The work to my vehicle looks great and has held up well. I encourage anyone to try this great local shop.

reviews.author: Anne-Marie McGuire
reviews.text: I ran over a car block like an absolute idiot right before my grandfathers funeral and on the way home to Jersey, our car started making terrible noises. This auto body shop was closing and when I tell you it is 98 degrees, it feels like 107. A young man named Cooper came out to look at my car, and got down on his hands and knees and fixed it up so we could get home. He refused a tip, didn’t let us pay him. Even refused snacks. What a good person. We are eternally grateful.

reviews.author: Jared Goodrum
reviews.text: I went to several shops before I came to Donnie and they all just gave me a huge price and basically said take it or leave it. When I went to Donnie he sat down with me and looked all over the internet trying to find the part I needed and we finally found it. Once we found it he gave me an awesome price to fix the repair which was much cheaper then everyone else. Especially, being a college student it helped a lot. Once the part came in I took my truck to Donnie and he got it repaired and the next time I saw it it looked like I was never in an accident. Highly recommend Greenville Auto Body great customer service and great quality work!

reviews.author: Macie Yao
reviews.text: This business tried to charge me $1179 for a minor paint scratch on my car. I went to another shop and the quote was $275. I’m honestly more confused than anything. Don’t come here if you look like you don’t know much about cars, they will try to severely overcharge you.

reviews.author: Aidan Wood
reviews.text: Do not leave any personal belonging in your car. Because they will steal it. They emptied out my entire center console to “fix my bumper”. Stole my AirPods and phone charger but left a dollar bill for me. So sleezy. Would never recommend.

reviews.author: Blake Johnsen
reviews.text: Donnie and his staff did an excellent job. Had someone hit the front end of my car and they had it looking better than before the wreck. Would definitely recommend this shop to anyone in need of quality repairs.

reviews.author: Janni Wood
reviews.text: When life happens to your vehicle do yourself a favor and call Donnie at Greenville Auto Body and Paint. He has repaired two of my family's cars and each time the work was outstanding! My Ford F150 looks like it just came off the showroom floor. There are not enough superlatives to describe his customer service and the actual work done

reviews.author: sallie hardy
reviews.text: This is my third time in for different reason for two vehicles. Each time I have had the same satisfied results. Donnie Garris is very personable and trustworthy. The work is top notch!!

reviews.author: Patrick Reid
reviews.text: Donnie is great at what he does, and has a great eye for detail. He has repaired multiple vehicles for my wife and I, and I am always exceptionally pleased with his work. He is honest, fair, and skilled - a rare combination.

reviews.author: Grant Mackey
reviews.text: I got some vinyl work done on my car. 10/10 would recommend this place did a fantastic job. They even washed my car for me. Great guy, treats you with respect.

reviews.author: Lauren Howard
reviews.text: Went for a quote on my cars front bumper, (based off their Google reviews) and was HIGHLY impressed with their service and customer service. Love a local auto body shop and definitely recommend for anyone looking for a shop that is straight up with you, no run around, and customer oriented.

reviews.author: Janelle Spearman
reviews.text: If I could use zero stars I would! I just called and a gentleman answered the phone. I politely asked if they accepted Geico estimates. The reply I received was: “We are pretty much booked through the end of the year!” Clearly that’s not what I asked.

reviews.author: Jose Rangel
reviews.text: Have had work done on my car two times by Donnie, both times the car has came out looking great and would definitely go here again. Very friendly business.

reviews.author: Sheila Staton
reviews.text: My experience is beyond amazing! Carstar did an awesome work. I highly recommend Carstar to anyone looking for body work!

reviews.author: Stephanie S
reviews.text: My car looks great, very satisfied with my experience here. Donnie is the best and he really cares about his craft!

reviews.author: Emmanuel Moreno
reviews.text: The service from Donnie was great! The job was done within a day and I couldn’t be happier with the work. Definitely a must go for quality body work!

reviews.author: Darien Talbert
reviews.text: Got damage from someone backing into me fixed here. The service was expedient and well done. Would definitely go back again if need be and would definitely reccomend to friends and family.

reviews.author: Jillian French
reviews.text: They were amazing and attentive and kept me in the loop the whole time! Would absolutely go back as well as recommend to others

reviews.author: James Teague
reviews.text: Excellent repair work and excellent service. Donnie is a people person and is easy to talk to. I wouldn't go anywhere else

reviews.author: Johnny Looseround
reviews.text: Excellent place to do business. My daughter has wrecked a time or 5 and he and his crew made my cars new again.

reviews.author: Vanessa McKinney
reviews.text: Quality work and excellent customer service! They are honest, efficient and genuinely care about their customers! I would definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Cory Kimball
reviews.text: Great customer service, excellent work on the car, and helped as much as possible to keep the cost low.

reviews.author: Earl Hampton
reviews.text: Exceptionally helpful. They took extra time and made sure i understood my options and what to expect from insurance bureaucracy going forward.

reviews.author: Bobo Lloyd
reviews.text: YOU DIDN'T GET THAT $20 BECAUSE YOU NEVER DONE WHAT YOU TOLD ME YOU WHERE GOING TO DO...TOUCH UP THE CHIP ON THE NOISE!!! AS FAR AS THE PAINT...IF YOU DIDN'T GET IT IN THE RT LIGHT IT LOOKED LIKE IT DIDN'T MATCH...MOST PEOPLE SAID THAT!!! LET ALONE THE BUMP NOT BEING LINED UP ON BOTH SIDE!!!
